<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Hexagonal, functional core / imperative shell, constructor injection. core::prep owns every DTO and port; it has no I/O, Parquet, SQLite or engine dependency. Adapter crates implement PrepFold: pure, deterministic interpretation of supplied native input (JSONL records or a whole snapshot) into typed rows plus SessionFacts with a versioned checkpoint; no filesystem, clock or environment. Loaders implement PrepLoader: read-only discovery with skip accounting, stat, bounded reads to the last complete LF, prefix anchors, one-record reads at a native address. The SDK owns all prep semantics (root binding, change detection, generations, live tails, checkpoint compatibility, parallelism) and exposes fold_source, the single-source fold that prep, Plan 029 session status and external consumers share. output-prep implements PrepStore and is the only crate that knows Parquet/Arrow. The CLI turns argv into requests and renders reports; it holds no prep semantics. crates/app is the only composition root. No analytical engine is linked; research runs in external DuckDB over published Parquet. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/main.rs dispatches; crates/app/src/prep.rs (new) holds the bindings table harness → {fold, loader}, resolves default roots from the adapter catalogue LocationHint (base + path) and HOME, merges explicit --root sets and opens ParquetPrepStore. Nothing else constructs concrete loaders, folds or stores. |
| contracts | core::prep (crates/core/src/prep.rs) is the single contract: PREP_TABLE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2, PREP_CHECKPOINT_FORMAT = 1. No Parquet, Arrow, SQLite, engine, filesystem or clock dependency in core or sdk (arch-check)., Sources: PrepSourceKind {Append, Snapshot}. PrepSourceSet {harness, label, root: PathBuf}; label "default" is the catalogue root, explicit roots default to "root-&lt;first 8 hex of sha256(absolute root)&gt;" unless named. Source key = "&lt;harness&gt;/&lt;label&gt;/&lt;path relative to root&gt;" and is the stable key in every table. PrepSourceStat {path, file (relative), kind, identity, size, mtime_ns} (snapshot loaders fold SQLite -wal/-shm sidecars into size/mtime). PrepSkipCounts {symlinks, hidden, unreadable_entries}. PrepDiscovery {sources, skipped}. NativeAddress {offset: Option&lt;u64&gt;, key: Option&lt;String&gt;}., Rows (PrepRows {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}); every row starts (source, generation, native_offset, native_key). calls: sighting first\|update, msg_id, request_id, ts, ts_ms, model, stop_reason (last non-null), input, cw_1h, cw_5m, cache_read, output, cache_write_basis (split\|fallback_1h\|fallback_5m\|none), is_sidechain, gap_ms, turn_no, call_in_turn, records. turns: turn_no, started_ts, started_ts_ms, first_call_offset, origin (start\|human\|peer\|task_notification\|coordinator\|auto_continuation\|loop\|compact\|subagent_task\|system\|other), sender, pij_msg_id, opener_offset, opener_ts_ms, opener_chars, body_key. triggers: ts, ts_ms, kind, sender, pij_msg_id, chars, body_key, next_turn_no, content_head (only with include_content). events: ts, ts_ms, kind (compaction\|recap\|scheduled_fire\|limit_notice\|queue_op\|model_switch\|api_error\|system_other), subkind, trigger, model (model_switch: requested model), pre_tokens, post_tokens (native compact_boundary postTokens only), duration_ms, last_context, gap_ms, resets_at (native phrase), resets_at_ms (parsed only when the source allows), turn_no, body_key. tool_uses: sighting use\|result, tool_use_id, call_msg_id, name (native), family, input_hash, input_bytes, result_offset, result_bytes, outcome (ok\|error\|unknown), duration_ms (native only), turn_no. Unknown or unrecorded = null, never estimated., SessionFacts (core; the SDK-level contract Plan 029 session-status and Flowspace3 reuse without a target dir): session_id, parent_session_id, is_sidechain, cwd, first_event_ts/_ms and last_event_ts/_ms (latest native event timestamp, never mtime), records, calls, turns, latest_context: Option&lt;ContextSample {ts_ms, model, stop_reason, input, cache_read, cache_write, total}&gt; (latest deduplicated main-chain call; sidechain calls excluded), compactions: Option&lt;CompactionCounts {manual, auto, unknown_trigger}&gt; (None only when the dialect has no native compaction marker), last_compaction: Option&lt;{ts_ms, trigger, pre_tokens, post_tokens, first_context_after}&gt; (first_context_after = context of the first new main-chain call after the boundary, None until one exists), last_model_switch: Option&lt;{ts_ms, requested_model}&gt;, seat_hint, skipped {malformed, untimed, bad_timestamp}. PrepSourceMeta {is_sub, agent_id, project} comes from PrepFold::describe(file), never from the store., trait PrepLoader: kind() -&gt; PrepSourceKind; discover(&self, root: &Path, accept: &dyn Fn(&str) -&gt; bool) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepDiscovery&gt;; stat(&self, root: &Path, path: &Path) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepSourceStat&gt;; read(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, from: Option&lt;&ReadCursor&gt;, limits: PrepReadLimits) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepBatch&gt;; anchor(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, offset: u64) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; (Append only; Snapshot returns Unsupported); record_at(&self, path: &Path, address: &NativeAddress, max_bytes: usize) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;u8&gt;&gt;. PrepBatch {input: PrepInput, next_cursor: Option&lt;ReadCursor&gt;, more, incomplete_tail, bytes_read}; PrepInput = Records(Vec&lt;NativeRecord&gt;) \| Snapshot(NativeSnapshot). Append reads stop at the last complete LF. Loaders open native stores read-only and never lock, rename or write them., trait PrepFold (pure, in adapter crates): harness() -&gt; &'static str; policy() -&gt; &'static str; kind() -&gt; PrepSourceKind; pattern() -&gt; &'static str (glob relative to the root); describe(&self, file: &str) -&gt; PrepSourceMeta; open(&self, meta: &PrepSourceMeta, generation: u32, saved: Option&lt;&PrepCheckpoint&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;Box&lt;dyn PrepFoldSession&gt;&gt;; a saved checkpoint with another policy or format is refused (InvalidData), never reinterpreted. trait PrepFoldSession: fold(&mut self, input: &PrepInput, options: PrepOptions) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepRows&gt;; checkpoint(&self) -&gt; PrepCheckpoint {format, policy, fold: serde_json::Value}; facts(&self) -&gt; SessionFacts. Equal (checkpoint, input, options) give equal output; folding a stream in any batch split, or resuming from a checkpoint, equals one uninterrupted fold., trait PrepStore: state(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;PrepState&gt;&gt; (read-only); load(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepLoaded {state, orphans_removed}&gt; (recovers a crashed run); commit(&self, rows: &PrepRows, state: &PrepState) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCommit&gt; (rows durable first, state published last by atomic rename); compact(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCompactReport&gt;. An implementation excludes concurrent writers for its lifetime. PrepState {table_schema_version, checkpoint_format, runs, parts, sets: BTreeMap&lt;set key, PrepSetState {harness, label, root, policy}&gt;, sources: BTreeMap&lt;source key, PrepSourceState {set, path, file, kind, identity, size, mtime_ns, offset, anchor, revision, generation, meta, checkpoint, facts, status}&gt;}., Outcomes: PrepSourceStatus = New \| Unchanged \| Appended \| Replaced {reason: Rotated\|Truncated\|Rewritten\|Revision\|Policy\|Schema\|RootMoved} \| Unreadable \| Unsupported \| Missing. PrepReport {target, table_schema_version, run, sets: Vec&lt;PrepSetReport {harness, label, root, policy, supported, discovered, skipped: PrepSkipCounts, by_status}&gt;, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, rows_written: PrepTableCounts {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}, commit, sources: Vec&lt;PrepSourceOutcome&gt; (every source whose status is not Unchanged)}., PrepApi (core; the CLI's only prep dependency): prep(&PrepRequest) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepReport&gt;; compact(&PrepCompactRequest {target}) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCompactReport&gt;; record(&PrepRecordRequest {target, source, address, include_content}) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepRecord&gt;. PrepRequest {target, roots: Vec&lt;PrepSourceSet&gt;, options: PrepOptions {include_content}, limits: PrepReadLimits {read: ReadLimits, snapshot: SnapshotLimits}, threads, modified_since_ns}. record with include_content = false is refused (InvalidInput) before any native read., SDK (crates/sdk/src/prep.rs): Preparer::new(bindings: Vec&lt;PrepBinding {fold: Arc&lt;dyn PrepFold&gt;, loader: Arc&lt;dyn PrepLoader&gt;}&gt;, store: S) implements PrepApi; a root whose harness has no binding is reported supported = false with its sources Unsupported. fold_source(loader: &dyn PrepLoader, fold: &dyn PrepFold, stat: &PrepSourceStat, resume: Option&lt;&PrepResume&gt;, options: PrepOptions, limits: PrepReadLimits, sink: &mut dyn FnMut(PrepRows)) -&gt; Result&lt;SourceFold {checkpoint, facts, cursor, anchor, revision, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes}&gt; is the single-source in-memory fold used by run_prep, Plan 029 and external consumers., Table contract (output-prep only): TARGET/state.json; TARGET/tables/{calls,turns,triggers,events,tool_uses}/*.parquet append-only parts; TARGET/tables/{sources,sessions}.parquet current snapshots; Parquet key-value metadata unisphere.table_schema_version; TARGET/views.sql (DuckDB) defining calls_v (current generation, grouped by (source, generation, msg_id, request_id) with per-field max, stop_reason last non-null), turns_v, triggers_v, events_v, compactions_v (with first_context_after), tool_uses_v (use+result merged), sources_v, sessions_v. Column names avoid SQL reserved words. Compaction rewrites current-generation rows only and changes no view result., CLI argv (frozen): unisphere prep --target DIR [--root HARNESS[:LABEL]=DIR]... <a id="fan-out"></a>

## Fan out

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| decision | coders |
| rationale | Phase 1 splits into four behaviours that run and prove independently against the sealed v2 contract and testkit fakes: the Claude fold (pure, fixture-driven), the incremental engine (SDK + JSONL loader, driven by RecordingFold and MemoryPrepStore), the Parquet store (driven by synthetic PrepRows/PrepState) and the CLI frontend (driven by a fake PrepApi). The coupling that could force them together — state semantics shared by engine and store — is removed by freezing PrepState and the load/commit/compact protocol in the baseline. Integration (composition root, catalogue, proof mode, real-corpus parity) stays with the PM. Coders never import sibling implementations in the same wave. Phase 2 cannot share this roster: builder composition imports every coder of a guide exactly once on one frozen baseline, and phase-2 lanes must start from the verified phase-1 composition. Phase 2 is therefore guide v2 (re-reviewed, re-sealed on the phase-1 composed SHA) with these planned lanes: Oh My Pi and Pi prep folds; Codex prep fold; Copilot CLI prep folds; VS Code Copilot prep fold; Cursor prep folds; Snapshot prep loader; Research recipes; Phase-2 composition and full-corpus proof. Each phase-2 fold lane also flips its own descriptor's cli_persisted_resume, so adapter lib.rs files have one writer. |

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text | check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rk-0001 | Reference-parser semantics differ at window boundaries (prior-call state) and at 0.1 s gap-rounding ties; parity could be rounded away. | vd-000a reports every diverging field/row; divergences need reviewer acceptance. |
| rk-0002 | Fold checkpoints retain every committed call key; state.json grows with history and is rewritten per commit. | vd-000b reports state.json bytes and commit time on the full corpus. |
| rk-0003 | A same-size, same-mtime in-place rewrite is invisible to the stat fast path until the next growth. | vd-0003 pins detection at next growth by anchor; the prep docs topic states the limit. |
| rk-0004 | SQLite WAL growth can leave the main file's size/mtime unchanged; snapshot sources re-read wholly on change. | vd-0013 covers WAL-only growth; vd-000b reports snapshot bytes read. |
| rk-0005 | Two prep runs on one target could interleave parts and state. | vd-0004 proves the second writer is refused while the first holds the lock. |
| rk-0006 | Existing query mappings omit Codex model, VS Code and Cursor IDE usage; prep could inherit the gaps silently. | vd-000f, vd-0011 and vd-0012 assert values where the synthetic native record carries them and nulls where it does not. |
| rk-0007 | No DuckDB CLI is installed on this machine; the recipes proof needs an operator-approved install. | vd-000c fails with the actionable message until DuckDB is present. |
| rk-0008 | The baseline adapts POC files that wave-1 units then own; stale assumptions could leak. | harness builder on-track warnings at import; baseline adaptation is compile-level only. |
| rk-0009 | Flowspace3's wider observation seam (roles, text parts, request markers) is outside this plan's ACs; only fold_source, SessionFacts and the checkpoint are promised. | vd-0008 proves the external consumer path; the gap is stated in the prep topic. |
| rk-000a | Real prompts or identifiers could leak into fixtures or committed evidence. | Synthetic fixtures only; content columns null by default (vd-0002, vd-0005); proof scripts write only to .harness/temp and print numbers; reviewer inspects committed evidence. |
| rk-000b | Rows for a whole run are buffered before commit; memory could scale with corpus size. | vd-000b records peak RSS against the documented bound and the --threads / --max-batch-bytes controls. |
